_comment: SHAPE REFERENCE for scripts/import-legacy-orders.mjs. Fictional data.
The real file is server/data/legacy-orders.json, which is deliberately NOT
committed: it holds actual customer names, company names and mobile numbers,
and this repository is public. Keep it locally and run the import from there.
Money is written in RUPEES, exactly as the source spreadsheet records it. The
importer converts to integer paise at the boundary — never put paise here.
Reconciliation, which is the subtle part: 'received' on an order is the master
ledger's per-order figure, while entries in 'receipts' are dated payments
recorded against a CUSTOMER ACCOUNT, not against one order. The importer pools
each customer's receipts and allocates them oldest-order-first, so a payment
that settles two orders lands correctly on both. Give every receipt the id of
any order belonging to the right customer; the date and amount do the work.
